items.title: All Unity Catalog managed tables will be upgraded to catalog commits
items.text: After Databricks Runtime 15.4 LTS reaches end of support on August 19, 2027, Azure Databricks will upgrade all Unity Catalog managed tables to use catalog commits. With catalog commits, Unity Catalog becomes the system of coordination for your tables. This enables multi-statement, multi-table transactions, writes from external engines, and consistent governance across all engines. See Catalog commits.

items.id: November_10_2026#Feature: You can use graph measures to lock an aggregation to a key in order to perform complex aggregations without overcounting.
items.title: You can use graph measures to lock an aggregation to a key in order to perform complex aggregations without overcounting (GA)
items.text: You can use graph measures to lock an aggregation to a key in order to perform complex aggregations without overcounting. Measure expressions can include the following: Aggregate function calls Expressions within aggregate functions Conditional logic within aggregate functions Conditional distinct counting Scalar operations and expressions outside of aggregate functions Combinations of measures wrapped in the AGG function To query measures, you transform your graph into a flattened table by using the GRAPH_EXPAND TVF, and then query measures in that table with the AGG function. The GRAPH_EXPAND function now supports multiple fact tables. To view the output schema of the GRAPH_EXPAND function, use the BQ.SHOW_GRAPH_EXPAND_SCHEMA system procedure. You can define extensions in the OPTIONS clause of the labels and properties in your graphs, which are string pairs that represent custom metadata for natural language querying.
